items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Heavy target share shift to Addison/Hockenson

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib injury.
items.why: Rib injury after hard hit, carted
items.implication: 49ers already thin at WR; targets scarce
items.opportunity: Routes to Deebo Samuel (22), Cowing, Hodge on Purdy dropbacks

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury.
items.opportunity: Full backfield workload to remaining Jets RBs

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury.
items.why: Knee injury during game, ruled out remainder
items.implication: Major loss for MIA backfield; monitor testing

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers active vs Cowboys after pregame workout; was GTD.
items.why: Looked good on field workout, cleared to play

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) left early; 49ers already down four WRs. On 29 Purdy dropbacks: Deebo 22 routes, Cowing 14, Hodge 13, Watkins 8; group combined 4 targets.
items.implication: Low target efficiency for remaining; Deebo lead
items.opportunity: Deebo high snap/route share as primary

items.text: Bears expected to start Case Keenum at QB vs Eagles; Caleb Williams ruled out (hamstring), Bagent cleared but not starting.
items.why: Williams hamstring; Keenum preferred over Bagent
items.opportunity: Lowered targets for Odunze/Burden/Moore; check Keenum ceiling

items.text: Commanders expected to sign FA RB Austin Ekeler to 53-man roster pending physical; healed from Achilles.
items.why: Healed Achilles, prior WAS success ~5 ypc
items.implication: Committee/backup RB depth for WAS; Daniels out elbow
items.opportunity: Potential goal-line/third-down role vs current backs

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb; MRI upcoming, likely to miss time.
items.implication: Backup QB starts next; McMillan also knee
items.opportunity: TB pass game uncertainty; handcuff TE/WRs

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers active and making 2026 season debut.
items.opportunity: High target share expected as featured TE

items.text: If Zay Flowers active for Baltimore, start him over Bateman; risky but preferred.
ETR had Zay Flowers out in initial projections (late Bateman/Andrews swap possible); Moore limited, Mitchell out confirmed. High opportunity for Garrett Wilson post-Mitchell.
items.why: Hamstring; team not counting on him; Mitchell finger inactive
items.implication: Wilson WR1 with elevated targets; Sadiq hybrid slot
items.opportunity: Wilson high route/target share; Jets WR depth thin

items.text: Giants pass rusher Brian Burns believed to have torn ACL; played through ankle then knee injury.
items.implication: Major defensive loss; Giants already thin (Dart IR)
